description: Posted price schedule for the mKOTO economy per ADR-2605282100 L2. Versioned (semver-ish date string) and signed by Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain. R1.3a launch defaults are documented in ADR-2605282100 §'Initial tariff' (litellm-gateway: 100 mKOTO/gpu_sec + 10 mKOTO/MB; evo-x2: 250+10; mac-mini own-node: 30+5; webgpu-wasm: 1 mKOTO/1k gas). R2 ratification requires Council Lv6+ ≥3 attestation chain emitting a new version record. NEVER allows commercial GPU rental endpoints — only the Murakumo fleet kinds present in 50-infra/murakumo/fleet.toml (ADR-2605215000 + ADR-2605282100 N6).

version.description: Tariff version string (e.g. '2026-05-28' or 'r1.3a-launch'). Caller-side ndjson + balance/usage records reference this string so price-change reconciliation is exact.

rows.description: One row per fleet endpoint kind. Endpoint kind values MUST match the `backend` field of kotoba_murakumo._internal.routing.ResolvedRoute (e.g. 'litellm-gateway', 'evo-x2', 'mac-mini/<tribe>', 'webgpu-wasm').

councilAttestations.description: Council Lv6+ DIDs that attested this tariff version (per ADR-2605192300). Minimum 3-of-7 supermajority; 4+ on R2 critical-economy rev cycles.

signedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant of the latest signer's attestation.

supersedes.description: Prior tariff version this record supersedes; optional for v1 launch.

calibrationNote.description: Free-text rationale for the price calibration (e.g. PG&E rate basis, hardware amortization schedule, mKOTO-to-USDC ratio reference).

gpu_second_mkoto.description: mKOTO charged per GPU-second of dispatch latency. 0 for kotoba-vm gas-priced backends.

egress_mb_mkoto.description: mKOTO charged per MB of response body egress.

gas_per_1k_mkoto.description: mKOTO charged per 1000 gas-units consumed (webgpu-wasm only; 0 for HTTP-routed backends).
